Frequently asked questions

Aircraft, propulsion and engineering visits.

What is the RAJAS RJS-H1?

It is Raj’s hydrogen-hybrid fixed-wing unmanned aircraft designed for vertical take-off and landing. See the aircraft overview and capability statement for the published platform figures.

How does the aircraft use hydrogen?

A battery provides power for electric lift. A hydrogen fuel cell supplies electric power during forward flight. Read about the propulsion system.

Can our evaluation team visit Raj in Pune?

Evaluation teams can request a visit to discuss the aircraft and see where design and assembly take place. Choose Engineering visit in the enquiry form.

Can we request quality documentation?

Raj makes process records available for customer inspection. Certifications and approvals are available on request. Choose Quality documentation in the enquiry form.

What programmes are still in development?

The RAJAS Heavy-Lift programme is in development. The product page marks its performance figures as design targets.
